title: A single pro-etale covering carries compatible root generators and trivializes all the constructed integral, rational and algebraic-closure coefficien
statement:
Fix a prime $\ell$, a scheme $X$ on which $\ell$ is invertible in every residue field, and an algebraic closure $\overline{\mathbf Q}_\ell$ of $\mathbf Q_\ell$. Use the universe convention [def-weil-size-convention] and the small pro-etale site $C=X_{\mathrm{pro\acute et}}$ [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site]. Write $M_n=\mu_{\ell^{n+1},X}$, with its $(\mathbf Z/\ell^{n+1})_X$-module structure and power transition $t_n:M_{n+1}\to M_n$ [def-pur-roots-of-unity-sheaf]. Use precisely the constructed finite, integral, rational and sheafified-colimit twists $A_X(1)$, $\mathcal O_{E,X}(1)$, $E_X(1)$ and $\overline{\mathbf Q}_{\ell,X}(1)$ of [sk-def-sp-tate-twist], where $E$ ranges over all finite intermediate extensions of $\mathbf Q_\ell$ in the fixed algebraic closure. Internal modules are read as sectionwise module sheaves through [def-weil-pbc-internal-abelian-sheaf-module-equivalence]. The notation $F|_U$ means restriction to $C/U$ [def-pur-localized-ringed-site].

There exist an index type $I$ in the site universe, objects $U_i$ of $C$, arrows $f_i:U_i\to X$ forming a pro-etale covering family, sections $\zeta_{n,i}\in M_n(U_i)$ for every $n\geq0$, and isomorphisms
$$e_{n,i}:(\mathbf Z/\ell^{n+1})_X|_{U_i}\xrightarrow{\sim}M_n|_{U_i}$$
such that:
1. $t_n(\zeta_{n+1,i})=\zeta_{n,i}$, and for every $v:V\to U_i$ and every $a\in(\mathbf Z/\ell^{n+1})_X(V)$ the component of $e_{n,i}$ sends $a$ to $a\cdot v^*\zeta_{n,i}$ (additive module notation for exponentiation of roots).
2. For every finite commutative ring $A$, every $r\geq0$ with $\ell^{r+1}=0$ in $A$, and every $i$, there is an $A_X|_{U_i}$-linear isomorphism $A_X(1)|_{U_i}\cong A_X|_{U_i}$; the finite twist here uses the unique unital scalar map $\mathbf Z/\ell^{r+1}\to A$.
3. For every finite intermediate field $E$ and every $i$, there are isomorphisms $\mathcal O_{E,X}(1)|_{U_i}\cong\mathcal O_{E,X}|_{U_i}$ and $E_X(1)|_{U_i}\cong E_X|_{U_i}$, linear over their respective restricted coefficient rings.
4. For every $i$ there is a $\overline{\mathbf Q}_{\ell,X}|_{U_i}$-linear isomorphism $\overline{\mathbf Q}_{\ell,X}(1)|_{U_i}\cong\overline{\mathbf Q}_{\ell,X}|_{U_i}$.
The same family $U_i$ works for all the quantified coefficients and indices. No quasi-compactness hypothesis is imposed on $X$.

proof.text: Apply Scheme.tateTwist_finite_locallyFree to obtain one covering family U_i, compatible root sections zeta_n,i, normalized root basis isomorphisms e_n,i, and the finite coefficient clause. Keep the cover and both normalization identities verbatim. For each finite A killed by ell^(r+1), its nsmul vanishing follows by nsmul_eq_mul. The quotient scalar homomorphism returned by the finite theorem equals the displayed ZMod.castHom by subsingleton uniqueness. Specialize its signed-line local triviality to degree one; scalarTensorPower at one is the original line. This proves precisely the finite twist clause, including A the zero ring.

For every finite intermediate E and every i, apply lem-sp-integral-rational-root-basis on W=U_i to the sections and normalized isomorphisms supplied by the first step. Their compatibility and normalization hypotheses are exactly the corresponding two clauses of that step. This gives both integral and rational signed-degree-one to signed-degree-zero isomorphisms on that same cover.

For each i apply lem-sp-qbar-root-basis to the very same supplied root sections, isomorphisms and identities on W=U_i. It gives the algebraic-closure local isomorphism on that same cover. Package these clauses with the original covering, sections, root identities and finite isomorphisms.

theorem spTwists_commonCover
    [∀ x : X, Invertible (ℓ : X.residueField x)] :
    ∃ (I : Type (u + 1)) (U : I → X.ProEt)
      (f : ∀ i : I, U i ⟶ Scheme.ProEt.mk (𝟙 X))
      (ζ : ∀ (n : ℕ) (i : I), (Scheme.purTwistRootsModule X ℓ n).val.obj (op (U i)))
      (e : ∀ (n : ℕ) (i : I),
        (SheafOfModules.unit (Scheme.purTwistRing X (Scheme.purTwistFiniteRing X ℓ n))).over
            (U i) ≅ (Scheme.purTwistRootsModule X ℓ n).over (U i)),
      Presieve.ofArrows U f ∈ (Scheme.ProEt.precoverage X).coverings _ ∧
      (∀ (n : ℕ) (i : I),
        (Scheme.proEtaleRootsOfUnityTransition X (ℓ ^ (n + 1)) (ℓ ^ (n + 2))
          (pow_pos (Fact.out : ℓ.Prime).pos _) (pow_pos (Fact.out : ℓ.Prime).pos _)
          (pow_dvd_pow ℓ (Nat.le_succ (n + 1)))).hom.app (op (U i))
            (ζ (n + 1) i) = ζ n i) ∧
      (∀ (n : ℕ) (i : I) (V : (Over (U i))ᵒᵖ)
        (a : ((Scheme.purTwistRing X (Scheme.purTwistFiniteRing X ℓ n)).over (U i)).obj.obj V),
        (e n i).hom.val.app V a =
          a • (Scheme.purTwistRootsModule X ℓ n).val.map V.unop.hom.op (ζ n i)) ∧
      (∀ (A : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing A] [Finite A] (r : ℕ)
        (hA : (ℓ ^ (r + 1) : A) = 0) (i : I),
        Nonempty ((spFiniteTwist X ℓ A r hA).over (U i) ≅
          (SheafOfModules.unit
            (Scheme.purTwistRing X (Scheme.tateFiniteCoefficient X A))).over (U i))) ∧
      (∀ (E : PadicAlgCl.FiniteIntermediateField ℓ) (i : I),
        Nonempty ((spSignedTwist X _ (spIntegralTwist X ℓ E) 1).over (U i) ≅
          (spSignedTwist X _ (spIntegralTwist X ℓ E) 0).over (U i)) ∧
        Nonempty ((spSignedTwist X _ (spRationalTwist X ℓ E) 1).over (U i) ≅
          (spSignedTwist X _ (spRationalTwist X ℓ E) 0).over (U i))) ∧
      ∀ i : I, Nonempty ((spSignedTwist X _ (spQbarTwist X ℓ) 1).over (U i) ≅
        (spSignedTwist X _ (spQbarTwist X ℓ) 0).over (U i)) := by
  sorry
